scope: EASA open-category baseline only. Country-specific insurance, geographical zones, filming and customs requirements are not yet covered.

registrationRequired.note: Operator registration generally applies at 250 g or more, and to camera-equipped drones below 250 g unless classified as toys.

pilotCertRequired.note: Competence requirements depend on class and subcategory; read the EASA requirements for your aircraft.

altitudeNote: Open-category baseline: within 120 m of the nearest point of the surface, subject to exceptions and lower geographical-zone limits.

insuranceRequired.note: Not verified in this summary. Check the national authority for your aircraft and operation.

importRestriction.note: Import and radio-equipment requirements have not been verified.

noFlyHighlights: No flights over assemblies of people; national geographical zones require separate checks.
notes: Desk research from official sources, not firsthand flight verification. Check current notices and site permissions before a flight.
